description:
TPO 05/17 - T1 (Copper beech) - Crown lift to give 5.4m clearance over the carriageway/access road and 4m clearance over footpaths cutting back to suitable growth points;
T2 (London plane) - crown lift to give 5.4m clearance over the carriageway/access road and 4m clearance over footpaths, reduce building-side lateral crown by up to 3m to suitable growth points reducing overall crown spread from approximately 21m to approximately 18m; and
T3 (Pear) - crown lift to give 5.4m clearance over the carriageway/access road and 4m clearance over footpaths cutting back to suitable growth points.

TPO 36/08 - T4 (Lime) - re-pollard by up to 6m back to previous pollard points; and
T5 (Hornbeam) - crown lift to 5.4m over access way, prune back from building by approximately 2.5m to suitable growth points reducing crown spread from approximately 13m to approximately 10.5m. (Summary).
